title: Square root procedure correctness
statement: Let a program contain the specified square root procedure, let $K$ be a natural number, and let $\mu$ be an initial memory function. If the word limit is at least $3K+4$, then on input $K$ the procedure runs within $18\lfloor\sqrt K\rfloor+12$ steps, returns $\lfloor\sqrt K\rfloor$, and leaves memory unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: The program contains the specified square root procedure
The initial memory function $\mu$ is given
The word limit is at least $3K+4$
